user.title: Cave Heating
user.description: Cave Heating sets itself up from the file cave/heating.yaml on the server.

abort.already_configured: Cave Heating is already set up.
abort.configured_by_file: Cave Heating is configured through the file cave/heating.yaml on the server and applied with ./cave apply. It sets itself up when Home Assistant starts; there is nothing to add here.

refused_room_off.message: {room} is switched off. Switch the room on before setting a temperature or preset.

refused_summer.message: The heating is off for the summer (home mode off), so {room} cannot be set. Switch the home mode to auto first.

reload_failed.message: The applied heating.yaml cannot be used, so the previous configuration stays in effect: {errors}

unknown_thermostat.message: {entity} is not a thermostat of any room in heating.yaml.

applied_file_invalid.title: The heating configuration is not valid

applied_file_missing.title: The heating configuration is missing
applied_file_missing.description: Cave Heating started without rooms because the applied file {path} does not exist. Describe the rooms in cave/heating.yaml on the server and run ./cave apply.

missing_entity.title: {room}: {entity} does not exist
missing_entity.description: heating.yaml names {entity} as {field} of the room {room}, but Home Assistant has no such entity. The room treats it as unavailable. Pair the device, or correct cave/heating.yaml and run ./cave apply.

reload_invalid.title: The new heating configuration was not loaded

unresponsive.title: {room}: {entity} does not respond
unresponsive.description: The thermostat {entity} in {room} did not confirm its commands, also after they were resent. It is tried again regularly. Check its battery and its connection.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Heats the chosen rooms at the boost temperature for a while.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the boost lasts. Default: the room's boost_duration from heating.yaml.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature to heat at. Default: the room's boost_temperature from heating.yaml.

hold.name: Hold a thermostat
hold.description: Keeps the controller away from one thermostat: it sends the thermostat nothing and adopts nothing from it until it is released or the hold ends by itself. Used by ./cave device-check.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the hold lasts at most, up to four hours. Default: 15 minutes.

entity_id.name: Thermostat
entity_id.description: The thermostat's climate entity, as named in heating.yaml.

release.name: Release a thermostat
release.description: Ends a hold. The thermostat is then brought in line with its room.

entity_id.name: Thermostat
entity_id.description: The thermostat's climate entity, as named in heating.yaml.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reads the applied copy of heating.yaml again. If it is not valid, the running configuration stays in effect.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Ends a boost or override in the chosen rooms.
